# plot_molecule_at_best_optuna_trials { #mofography.visualize.plot_molecule_at_best_optuna_trials }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-experimental">experimental</span> Plot Optuna-optimized adsorbate geometries stored on RAG nodes; niche screening viz.

```python
visualize.plot_molecule_at_best_optuna_trials(
    rag,
    molecule_atoms,
    molecule_name,
    **kwargs_plot_mesh,
)
```

Plot mesh traces for Optuna-optimized molecule geometries stored on RAG nodes.



## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

rag
    a RAG (Region Adjacency Graph) object
molecule_atoms
    an ASE Atoms object representing the molecule to be plotted
molecule_name
    The name of the molecule being plotted.



## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

    a list of traces, where each trace is a plot of a molecule at its best Optuna trial. The plot is
generated using the provided molecule's atomic positions and the van der Waals radii of its atoms.
The function uses the `spheres_for_positions` and `plot_mesh` functions from the `visualize` module.
